facts.fact: 他开篇自问：这个地方、这些想法、这些记忆都属于别人，它们为什么要认领我
facts.anchor: It doesn’t make sense. None of it does. This place; these thoughts; these memories. All belong to someone else.

facts.fact: 负片上的人影就是他用 Caroline 的衣服堆的雪人——大衣、不自然的姿势、地上的一圈雪
facts.anchor: The figure in the negative was the snowman he’d built using Caroline’s clothes.

facts.fact: 电塔的白噪音无法屏蔽：收音机、电视、耳塞、读书、连睡眠都不行
facts.anchor: That pylon. He could hear it now, a cosmic white noise that fogged his thoughts. Nothing could silence it: not the radio; not the intermittent TV; nor earplugs, nor reading, nor even sleep.

facts.fact: 雪中传来喊叫、嘲弄、歌唱的声音，在窗帘后面低语
facts.anchor: voices from the drifting snow, voices that called and taunted and sang, and whispered behind the curtains

facts.fact: Benn 的话：有些地方像电池，能蓄电。有些人也是
facts.anchor: Some places are like batteries. They hold a charge. Some people, too.

facts.fact: Lucy 的话：整片荒原全是死人，你若仔细看就能看见他们
facts.anchor: The whole of this moor is dead people, she’d said. You can see them if you look.

facts.fact: 他涌起一阵反抗：这太荒谬了，独自住在这里影响了他的思想
facts.anchor: He felt a sudden surge of revolt. This is ridiculous, he thought. Being here alone had affected his mind.

facts.fact: 他决定打电话试探：让我们打一个，看看谁来接
facts.anchor: ‘So, let’s call,’ he said aloud. ‘Let’s see who answers.’

facts.fact: 他自称 Arthur Sanderson 给养老院回话
护工回答：先生，Arthur Sanderson 就在这里——他是记忆护理病房的住户。Arthur 没有死
facts.anchor: ‘Because, sir, Arthur Sanderson’s here. He’s one of our memory-care residents.’
